selection: first test query by index in each of the fixed shared-six environments; not selected by method wins
findings: No obvious wrong-object detections in the reviewed panels. All six reviewed final-frame panels for each method track the depicted silver endpoint.
boundary_rule: Center of the visible in-frame box; not inferred full-object center outside the image.
scope_limits: Not an exhaustive video or 12-query audit.
No manually annotated pixel-center ground truth or measured localization error.
Intermediate-frame jumps/misses outside sampled times have not been ruled out.
Generated blur and boundary clipping limit exact center precision.
